name: DiucsServiceCriteria
title: DIUCS service criteria version
description: One version of a service's criteria: the needs it accepts and excludes, its age range and districts, and its status. The criteria elements (ageMin, status, version and the rest) are stored as properties (DEC-001), which R4B Basic does not hold, so only the profile rules are run on it, not the R4B structure check.
